message: Turn 36 fixed at 0121f8767aa3c0945bd0139cc4d8311389339c77, Dispatcher 2.2.10. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0. Failover semantics: raw.githubusercontent.com is tried once. A network-classified failure immediately tries the api.github.com contents endpoint for .agent-handoff/signal.json?ref=agent-handoff once. There is no same-host retry and no sleep inside fetch. Each attempt times out at 8 seconds, so the fetch is bounded by 16 seconds. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. Both responses pass through parse_signal. Invalid JSON, base64, or a non-object signal raises GitHubSignalError and is not accepted. If both endpoints fail with network errors, fetch raises GitHubNetworkError. Logs contain endpoint=raw|api|unavailable|signal and the exception class only. GitHubNetworkError and GitHubSignalError do not restart CDP. The 2.2.9 control-chat fixes and wake de-duplication are unchanged. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
